feats.title: Bloody Tenacity
feats.description: When you are bloodied for the first time in an encounter, you gain a +2 bonus to all defenses until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Avenging Spirit
feats.description: When an ally of at least your level drops to 0 hit points or fewer and you can see or hear that ally, gain an action point. It expires if unused at the end of your next turn.
